projects.title: E-Commerce Platform

projects.title: Task Management App

projects.title: Social Media Analytics
projects.description: Analytics dashboard for social media metrics with real-time data visualization and comprehensive reporting tools.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description: A modern real-time chat application with instant messaging, user authentication, responsive design, and seamless communication features

projects.title: Ticket Booking System
projects.description: A full-stack ticket booking platform that enables users to browse events, reserve and confirm seats, manage wallet transactions, transfer wallet balance, and allows administrators to manage events, bookings, seats, and refunds through a dedicated admin dashboard.

projects.title: Ticket Booking Admin Portal
projects.description: A comprehensive admin dashboard for managing a ticket booking platform. It enables administrators to create and manage events, monitor seat availability, oversee bookings, process wallet refunds, track transactions, and view real-time analytics through a secure and responsive interface.
